name: skillswap-monorepo
description: SkillSwap - Free Student-to-Student Skill Exchange Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix shared install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run db:push && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
